role: Deterministic appointed execution personnel with six measurable capabilities and three separate style trade-offs. Capability changes execution quality; style changes cost/completion/timing without owning forecast or target-position intent.

urgency.benefit_high: higher realized completion of authorized normal orders

passive_preference.cost_high: lower realized completion of authorized normal orders

window_timing.cost_high: foregoes front-loaded preference; result is path-dependent

invariants: every score accepts any finite decimal from 0 through 100 and maps continuously into runtime parameters
50.0 on every capability and style score is the exact v0.1 neutral execution baseline
capability dimensions are higher-is-better professional skills and may be summarized by capability_total_score
style dimensions are preferences with no total score and no universally superior endpoint
capability latent traits and style latent traits are generated separately so high skill does not imply one execution style
normal_order_completion_ratio scales the authorized discretionary order before market-capacity clipping; it is not merely a multiplier on a usually slack market limit
mandatory risk reductions bypass style order-completion penalties
urgency exchanges lower slippage for higher realized normal-order completion
passive preference exchanges spread cost for realized normal-order completion
hard exchange, clearing, cash-settlement, position-limit, margin, and market-capacity rules are never improved by personnel ability or style
execution completion can only reduce the authorized discretionary order; it cannot fabricate an order or exceed the authorized target
the execution desk never reads hidden future bars when scheduling orders
the same seed and candidate index generate the same profile and hash
players appoint generated personnel and do not submit arbitrary capability or style radars through the service API
TCA compares cost on realized executed orders with the neutral score-50 cost benchmark; completion shortfall is reported separately
execution personnel never change forecast direction, PM target-position intent, approved strategy limits, or public market liquidity
cross-department compatibility is never scored; fit emerges through actual target, risk and execution interfaces
